items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Charles is the drummer, used to work with Cecil Taylor and Steve Lacey (PHONETIC) and Billy Higgins was on part of that date, too

ctx.x: See, each one of us will be a leader and a side man on the other three dates, you know, other three days, which was a little taste of nice and I could take the money for four days' work. We was recording this down at a loft down on Grand Street, Dennis
Charles is the drummer, used to work with Cecil Taylor and Steve Lacey (PHONETIC) and Billy Higgins was on part of that date, too, along with Eddie Blackwell.

Anyway, we made that date and those dates at least and as yet, they have never been released. But that wasn't the only dates that Clifford and Harvey put up. We made some more. I'll get to that a little later.
